@comment model_path: model_path is model name which can be found in the input path of main function,required filed
@comment fps: fps means algorithm processing frame rate,default is 12.5
@comment vb_cnt: vb_cnt means buffer depth,which will be used to save store yuv scaled in the mscale module
@comment b_alarm: b_alarm means whether to do alarm processing,include jpeg encode,add&upload json message,option,default is 1
@comment alarm_interval: alarm_interval means alarm frequency,unit is second,option,default is 1
@comment sel_class: sel_class means the model attribute lable will be filterd, -1 means no filter,option,default is -1
@comment image_list: we can find image files path in image_list,which is used in file-reading mode
